parts:
hi Fraser,

The problem has to do with where nimble looks for user-defined distributions and functions. At the bottom of our example on parallelization, we have some syntax using assign() to make sure the user-defined distributions/functions are in the global environment of each worker, which is where nimble will look for them. So please add that use of assign() to your run_MCMC_allCode() function after you create the "d" and "r" functions. 

This is an aspect of the system we have some long-term development work ongoing to make things more user-friendly. But for now, this work-around should get you going.

Also, as a side note, this is a case where you shouldn't need to call registerDistributions(). For straightforward distributions like this, it should work to create the "d" (and in many cases the "r" is not needed) and then simply use it (but still using assign() when parallelizing).

-Chris
On Mon, Apr 5, 2021 at 1:50 AM fraser lewis <fraser.i...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi All,
I'm having an issue with an unregistered distribution using the parallel library. The non-parallel version works fine. I have put below two self-contained code examples - the first uses a custom pdf on a single core and works fine. The second uses the parallel library and gives an error about the pdf not being registered - I think I have registered it, so I guess I've not done it properly? 

Any thoughts or help much appreciated! thanks.
best wishes
Fraser

##################
The Error:
##################
Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) : one node produced an error: In sizeAssignAfterRecursing: 'rmysde' is not available or its output type is unknown. This occurred for: model_Observation2_latent[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,1)] <<- rmysde(=1,x0=model_Observation1_latent[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,1)],t=model_lifted_Time2_oBi_cB_minus_Time1_oBi_cB_L11[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,1)],alpha=model_a[1],K=model_K[1],sigma=model_sigma3[1]) This was part of the call: { model_Observation2_latent[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,1)] <<- rmysde(=1,x0=model_Observation1_latent[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,1)],t=model_lifted_Time2_oBi_cB_minus_Time1_oBi_cB_L11[getNodeFunctionIndexedInfo(ARG1_INDEXEDNODEINFO__,1)],alpha=model_a[1],K=model_K[1],sigma=model_sigma3[1]) }  

############################################
# self-contained code example - the first part runs fine, the second part not
###############################################################################################################
# SINGLE CORE VERSION
# works ok
###############################################################################################################

rm(list=ls());
############## DATA
data1 <-
structure(list(ID = c(38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 
38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L), Time1 = c(11, 12, 13, 14, 17, 
18, 19, 20, 25, 26, 27, 28, 32, 33), Observation1 = c(109.08, 
161.68000000000001, 275.70999999999998, 231.21000000000001, 299.63, 
455.69, 540, 713.75999999999999, 723.82000000000005, 819.04999999999995, 
791.57000000000005, 681.34000000000003, 999.44000000000005, 1067.6500000000001
), ID = c(38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 
38L, 38L, 38L), Time2 = c(12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 25, 26, 
27, 28, 32, 33, 34), Observation2 = c(161.68000000000001, 275.70999999999998, 
231.21000000000001, 299.63, 455.69, 540, 713.75999999999999, 
723.82000000000005, 819.04999999999995, 791.57000000000005, 681.34000000000003, 
999.44000000000005, 1067.6500000000001, 1132.1600000000001)), class = "data.frame", row.names = 331:344)


###########################################
library(nimble, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
###########################################

## custom density dXXXX
dmysde <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(x = double(0),                  # random variable value
                   x0 = double(0, default = 0),
                   t = double(0, default = 0),
                   alpha = double(0, default = 0),    
                   K = double(0, default = 0),
                   sigma = double(0, default = 1), # standard deviation
                   
                   log = integer(0, default = 0)) {
                         returnType(double(0))
                         # log pdf
                         logProb <- (1/2)*(
                                            -log(2*pi*t) - 2*log(x) - ((
                                                  ((t*sigma^2)/2) - log(K) + log(x) + 
                                                  (exp(-t*alpha))*(log(K) - log(x0)))^2)/(t*sigma^2) - 
                                          2*log(sigma)
                                          )
        if(log) return(logProb)
        else return(exp(logProb)) 
    })

## this is not strictly needed but here as a check - the mcmc sampler should generate the variate
## and so a stop() is used here to catch if this is used, in which case we need to switch sampler type
  rmysde <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(n = integer(0),
                   x0 = double(0, default = 0),
                    t = double(0, default = 0),
                   alpha = double(0, default = 0),    
                   K = double(0, default = 0),
                   sigma = double(0, default = 1)) {
                                      stop('rmynorm should never be run')
                                      returnType(double(0))
                             return(0)
    })
deregisterDistributions('dmysde')
registerDistributions('dmysde')

code <- nimbleCode({
  
  sigma1 ~ dunif(0, 1000)
  sigma2 ~ dunif(0, 1000)
  sigma3 ~ dunif(0, 1000)
  
  a ~ dnorm(0,sd=1000)
  K ~ dnorm(0,sd=1000)
  mu_t ~ dnorm(0,sd=1000)
  sigma_t ~ dunif(0, 1000)
  
  for(i in 1:n) {
     
      Observation1_latent[i]  ~ dnorm(mu_t,sd=sigma_t); # note = precision
      Observation1[i] ~ dnorm(Observation1_latent[i],sd=sigma1); # note = precision
 
      Observation2_latent[i] ~ dmysde(x0=Observation1_latent[i],t=Time2[i]-Time1[i],alpha=a,K=K,sigma=sigma3); # note sigma3=sd 
      
      Observation2[i]~dnorm(Observation2_latent[i],sd=sigma2); # note precision
     
       }
  
})

constants <- list(n = nrow(data1))
data <- list(Observation1 = data1$Observation1,Observation2 = data1$Observation2,
             Time1 = data1$Time1,Time2=data1$Time2)
inits <- list(a=0.1,K=1000,sigma2=10,sigma3=0.1,sigma1=0.1,mu_t=0.1,sigma_t=1.0,
              Observation1_latent=rep(0.1,nrow(data1)),
              Observation2_latent=rep(0.1,nrow(data1))
              )
              

model <- nimbleModel(code, constants = constants, data = data1, inits = inits) # build model

myMCMCconf <- configureMCMC(model) 

print(myMCMCconf);
myMCMC<-buildMCMC(myMCMCconf)

Cmodel <- compileNimble(model,resetFunctions = TRUE,showCompilerOutput = FALSE)
CmodelMCMC <- compileNimble(myMCMC, project = Cmodel,resetFunctions = TRUE,showCompilerOutput = FALSE)

seeds<-1;
MCMCsamples <- runMCMC(CmodelMCMC, niter = 100,thin=1,nchains=1,setSeed=seeds,
                   samplesAsCodaMCMC = FALSE)


###############################################################################################################
# PARALLEL VERSION
# fails! on missing rmydist function
###############################################################################################################
rm(list=ls())
############## DATA
data1 <-
structure(list(ID = c(38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 
38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L), Time1 = c(11, 12, 13, 14, 17, 
18, 19, 20, 25, 26, 27, 28, 32, 33), Observation1 = c(109.08, 
161.68000000000001, 275.70999999999998, 231.21000000000001, 299.63, 
455.69, 540, 713.75999999999999, 723.82000000000005, 819.04999999999995, 
791.57000000000005, 681.34000000000003, 999.44000000000005, 1067.6500000000001
), ID = c(38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 38L, 
38L, 38L, 38L), Time2 = c(12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 25, 26, 
27, 28, 32, 33, 34), Observation2 = c(161.68000000000001, 275.70999999999998, 
231.21000000000001, 299.63, 455.69, 540, 713.75999999999999, 
723.82000000000005, 819.04999999999995, 791.57000000000005, 681.34000000000003, 
999.44000000000005, 1067.6500000000001, 1132.1600000000001)), class = "data.frame", row.names = 331:344)

library(parallel)

Nnodes<-1;

this_cluster <- makeCluster(Nnodes)

run_MCMC_allcode <- function(seeds,dat) {
###########################################
library(nimble, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
###########################################

## custom density dXXXX
dmysde <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(x = double(0),                  # random variable value
                   x0 = double(0, default = 0),
                   t = double(0, default = 0),
                   alpha = double(0, default = 0),    
                   K = double(0, default = 0),
                   sigma = double(0, default = 1), # standard deviation
                   
                   log = integer(0, default = 0)) {
                         returnType(double(0))
                         # log pdf
                         logProb <- (1/2)*(
                                            -log(2*pi*t) - 2*log(x) - ((
                                                  ((t*sigma^2)/2) - log(K) + log(x) + 
                                                  (exp(-t*alpha))*(log(K) - log(x0)))^2)/(t*sigma^2) - 
                                          2*log(sigma)
                                          )
        if(log) return(logProb)
        else return(exp(logProb)) 
    })

## this is not strictly needed but here as a check - the mcmc sampler should generate the variate
## and so a stop() is used here to catch if this is used, in which case we need to switch sampler type
  rmysde <- nimbleFunction(
    run = function(n = integer(0),
                   x0 = double(0, default = 0),
                    t = double(0, default = 0),
                   alpha = double(0, default = 0),    
                   K = double(0, default = 0),
                   sigma = double(0, default = 1)) {
                                      stop('rmynorm should never be run')
                                      returnType(double(0))
                             return(0)
    })
  
deregisterDistributions('dmysde')

registerDistributions(list(
    dmysde = list(
        BUGSdist = "dmysde(x0,t,alpha,K,sigma)",
        types = c('value = double(0)', 'x0=double(0)','t=double(0)','alpha=double(0)','K=double(0)','sigma=double(0)')
        )
    ))


code <- nimbleCode({
  
  sigma1 ~ dunif(0, 1000)
  sigma2 ~ dunif(0, 1000)
  sigma3 ~ dunif(0, 1000)
  
  a ~ dnorm(0,sd=1000)
  K ~ dnorm(0,sd=1000)
  
   mu_t ~ dnorm(0,sd=1000)
  sigma_t ~ dunif(0, 1000)
 
  for(i in 1:n) {
     
      Observation1_latent[i]  ~ dnorm(mu_t,sd=sigma_t); # note = precision
      Observation1[i] ~ dnorm(Observation1_latent[i],sd=sigma1); # note = precision
 
      Observation2_latent[i] ~ dmysde(x0=Observation1_latent[i],t=Time2[i]-Time1[i],alpha=a,K=K,sigma=sigma3); # note sigma3=sd 
      
      Observation2[i]~dnorm(Observation2_latent[i],sd=sigma2); # note precision
     
       }
  
})

data1=dat[[1]];
constants <- list(n = nrow(data1))
data <- list(Observation1 = data1$Observation1,Observation2 = data1$Observation2,
             Time1 = data1$Time1,Time2=data1$Time2)
inits <- list(a=0.1,K=1000,sigma2=10,sigma3=0.1,sigma1=0.1,mu_t=0.1,sigma_t=1.0,
              Observation1_latent=rep(0.1,nrow(data1)),
              Observation2_latent=rep(0.1,nrow(data1))
              )
              

model <- nimbleModel(code, constants = constants, data = data1, inits = inits) # build model

myMCMCconf <- configureMCMC(model) 

print(myMCMCconf);
myMCMC<-buildMCMC(myMCMCconf)

Cmodel <- compileNimble(model,resetFunctions = TRUE,showCompilerOutput = FALSE)
CmodelMCMC <- compileNimble(myMCMC, project = Cmodel,resetFunctions = TRUE,showCompilerOutput = FALSE)

MCMCsamples <- runMCMC(CmodelMCMC, niter = 5000000,thin=500,nchains=4,setSeed=seeds,
                   samplesAsCodaMCMC = FALSE)

return(MCMCsamples);
}


chain_output <- parLapply(cl = this_cluster, X = 1:Nnodes, ## NOTE this is the seeds argument!
                          fun = run_MCMC_allcode, 
                          dat=list(data1) # this is one extra argument
                          )

# It's good practice to close the cluster when you're done with it.
stopCluster(this_cluster)

>> dmysde <- nimbleFunction(
>> run = function(x = double(0), # random variable value
>> x0 = double(0, default = 0),
>> t = double(0, default = 0),
>> alpha = double(0, default = 0),
>> K = double(0, default = 0),
>> sigma = double(0, default = 1), # standard deviation
>>
>> log = integer(0, default = 0)) {
>> returnType(double(0))
>> # log pdf
>> logProb <- (1/2)*(
>> -log(2*pi*t) - 2*log(x) - ((
>> ((t*sigma^2)/2) - log(K) + log(x) +
>> (exp(-t*alpha))*(log(K) - log(x0)))^2)/(t*sigma^2) -
>> 2*log(sigma)
>> )
>> if(log) return(logProb)
>> else return(exp(logProb))
>> })
